notes.title: Demo Patch Notes
notes.content:
Increased Traffic Variety: Added more traffic vehicles, including cars, campers and trucks.

New In-Game Shop: Introducing a Shop where you can purchase and unlock playable vehicles, new highways, and video effects.

New Score System: A new scoring system based on time, speed, and other factors has been introduced. Your score now converts into cash, which can be spent in the shop.

Checkpoint System Update: Checkpoints no longer add time. Instead, they now contribute the remaining time to your score and grant a fixed time bonus.

Fixed Equalizer Effect Button State: The "Equalizer Effect" button now correctly reflects whether the building equalizer lines are enabled or disabled.

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes
notes.content:
Added new camera views: Bonnet Cam, Bumper Cam, and an additional Far Chase Cam for a wider perspective

Selected camera view is now saved between sessions

Some camera views now have a wider field of view to enhance the sensation of speed

Fixed a bug that could cause an unexpected instant game over

Steering sensitivity is now adjustable in the settings
